title: Assessing the Physical Interpretability of AlphaEarth Foundation Embeddings Through Multi-Sensor Satellite Time-Series Benchmarking for Agricultural Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2611.34019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate and dynamic maps of agricultural LULC are important for agricultural water resource management, particularly in areas where water scarcity is prevalent, such as Morocco. Here, we evaluate the utility of AlphaEarth Foundation Model (AEF) embeddings for agricultural LULC and irrigation-type mapping in Morocco. AEF embeddings were compared to single-date and time-series remote-sensing features using three machine-learning classifiers: XGBoost, CatBoost, and TabPFN. We also evaluated whether AEF embeddings can: (a) provide an efficient and transferable alternative to conventional direct use of Earth observation products and (b) reconstruct biophysical information. Results showed that multi-temporal feature time series achieved the highest performance, with accuracies of 0.93 for agricultural LULC and 0.87 for irrigation-type mapping when using TabPFN. However, AEF embeddings yielded comparable results, achieving accuracies of 0.91

translated_title: 通过多传感器卫星时间序列基准测试评估AlphaEarth基础模型嵌入在农业制图中的物理可解释性
translated_abstract: 精确且动态更新的农业土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）地图对于农业水资源管理至关重要，尤其是在水资源普遍短缺的地区，例如摩洛哥。本研究评估了AlphaEarth基础模型（AEF）嵌入在摩洛哥农业LULC和灌溉类型制图中的效用。研究将AEF嵌入与单日期和多时相时间序列遥感特征进行了比较，使用了三种机器学习分类器：XGBoost、CatBoost和TabPFN。此外，本研究还评估了AEF嵌入是否能够：(a) 提供一种高效且可迁移的替代方案，以取代直接使用传统地球观测产品的方法；(b) 重建生物物理信息。结果表明，多时相特征时间序列取得了最高性能，使用TabPFN时农业LULC制图精度达到0.93，灌溉类型制图精度达到0.87。而AEF嵌入也取得了可比的结果，精度达到0.91。
tldr: 本研究在摩洛哥农业制图任务中对AlphaEarth基础模型嵌入与多传感器卫星时间序列特征进行了基准测试，发现AEF嵌入精度（0.91）接近多时相时间序列特征的最优结果（0.93），证明其可作为传统遥感产品的高效可迁移替代方案，并具备重建生物物理信息的潜力。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks AlphaEarth Foundation embeddings against multi-sensor satellite time-series features for agricultural LULC and irrigation mapping in Morocco, showing that AEF embeddings achieve comparable accuracy (0.91 vs 0.93) and demonstrating their potential as an efficient, transferable alternative to conventional Earth observation products with biophysical information reconstruction capability.
